newsitem.title: CANADA: Minorca says Busang interests secure.
newsitem.headline: Minorca says Busang interests secure.

text.p: Minorca Resources Inc said on Monday it confirmed that its Indonesian partner had no intention to sell its 10 percent interest in the rich Busang gold discovery in Indonesia.
Minorca said in a statement that it met with its partner, PT Askatindo Karya Mineral in Jakarta.
Minorca said Askatindo confirmed at the meeting that it still held and had no intention of selling its interest in the Busang southeast zones, Minorca said.
Calgary, Alberta-based Bre-X Minerals Ltd controls most of the huge deposit.
Askatindo reconfirmed its agreements with Minorca which give Minorca a seven percent interest in net profit from Busang production.

Minorca wanted to publicly confirm its agreement with Askatindo because of rampant rumors that Askatindo wanted to sell its interest in the property, Minorca spokeswoman Danielle Goldberg said in an interview.
"They want to be very clear they're not interested in selling."

Minorca also said that Askatindo saw no basis for being included in threatened legal action against Bre-X Minerals. Another of Bre-X's Indonesian partners, PT Krueng Gasui, has claimed up to 40 percent of the entire Busang discovery and threatened to sue Bre-X, Minorca, Askatindo and others unless its claims are settled.
Askatindo has told its lawyers to talk to Krueng Gasui, Minorca said.
